questions.paper: 03 Problem Solving and Data Analysis 专项练习（重录）

ledger.recompute: 1 份 = 5% 日限额 → x 份 = 5x%，p=5x；210 cal/50 fat 为干扰。选 B。

questions.stem: Jennifer bought a box of Crunchy Grain cereal. The nutrition facts on the box state that a serving size of the cereal is 3/4 cup and provides 210 calories, 50 of which are calories from fat. In addition, each serving of the cereal provides 180 milligrams of potassium, which is 5% of the daily allowance for adults. If p percent of an adult's daily allowance of potassium is provided by x servings of Crunchy Grain cereal per day, which of the following expresses p in terms of x?
